title: Strong Junior Python Developer
description:
We work with startups and established companies to create products in healthcare, fintech, eCommerce, and AI. This role offers real variety — new domains, evolving challenges, and steady professional growth instead of being locked into a single legacy system.
If you’re motivated by fast learning and building features that go live, this might be the right place for you.
What You'll Do
- Design and implement scalable backend solutions and contribute to architecture decisions
- Own features end-to-end — from technical discussion to production deployment
- Work closely with the client’s team on project tasks in English
- Optimize performance and improve existing systems
- Take responsibility for production stability and code quality
What We Work With
⚡ Python, FastAPI, Django, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, uv, Ruff
Gets You Extra Points
- Confident communication skills for requirement clarification
- Familiar with SQLModel, Alembic
- Used AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in daily workflow
- Practical experience working with AI/LLM integrations in real projects
- Experience working on production-ready applications
- Experience with full-stack development using React
What You Bring
- 1+ years of commercial backend development experience
- Strong knowledge of Python
- Solid understanding of REST APIs
- Experience working with SQL databases
- Ability to work independently and take ownership
- English: Upper-Intermediate (B2+) or higher — confident spoken and written communication with clients
What You Get
Work & Growth:
- Fully remote, flexible hours
- Structured code reviews
- Senior engineers who help you level up
- English practice sessions
Compensation:
- Salary in USD
- Performance reviews twice a year
- 15 days paid vacation + sick leave
